entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi... yes. I... I think I need to return something? I'm a bit confused about the process. It's a helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you happen to have your order number handy?
Um, I think so... one second. Okay, yes, it's VF-774-901.
Great, thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Aero-Pro helmet, delivered about 73 days ago. Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

Oh, I'm not sure what that means. I just... I got so overwhelmed when I was buying it. The website had so many choices, and the `color` isn't what I expected. I haven't even taken it out, the `box` is still `unopened`. I'm just worried about my `safety`, and I want to be sure I have the right gear. Can't you just help me? I'm so lost.
Of course, I can help you with that. It's completely understandable to want to feel confident in your equipment. Let me just double-check the return eligibility for you.
Okay... I hope it's not too late.
Not at all. I've just confirmed, and your `helmet` is well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process this for you.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief! So what do I do?

It's very simple. I've just approved the return in our system, and I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid shipping label. Since the `box` is `unopened`, you can just attach the label to it and drop it off at any shipping center.
Wow, that's it? Thank you so much, Diana. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, you'll get a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a safe ride.
